show_hn.q: Is the author presenting a project they made themselves (a Show HN style post)?
show_hn.true: The poster presents their own project, tool, app or creation.
show_hn.false: It is not the poster presenting their own creation.

ask_hn.q: Is this a question or discussion prompt posted to the community rather than a link to an article?
ask_hn.true: It asks the community a question or opens a discussion, with no external article.
ask_hn.false: It links to an external article, page or project.

research.q: Is this a research paper or preprint, or an article mainly reporting one study's findings?
research.true: It is a paper or preprint, or mainly reports a specific study.
research.false: It is not about a specific research paper or study.

tutorial.q: Does this teach the reader how to do something, step by step?
tutorial.true: It is a tutorial, guide or how-to.
tutorial.false: It does not teach a procedure.

opinion.q: Is this mainly an argued personal essay or opinion piece?
opinion.true: It argues a personal view or opinion.
opinion.false: It mainly reports, documents, announces or teaches.

news_event.q: Does this report a recent event, such as a release, outage, acquisition, lawsuit or death?
news_event.true: It reports a specific recent event.
news_event.false: It is not a report of a recent event.

business.q: Is this about a company's business: funding, earnings, layoffs, markets or strategy?
business.true: Its main subject is business, money or company strategy.
business.false: Business is not its main subject.

politics_policy.q: Is this about government, law, regulation, courts or elections?
politics_policy.true: Its main subject is politics, law or public policy.
politics_policy.false: Politics, law and policy are not its main subject.

ai_ml.q: Is this mainly about artificial intelligence or machine learning?
ai_ml.true: Its main subject is AI, ML or language models.
ai_ml.false: AI and ML are not its main subject.

product_pr.q: Is this a company announcing or promoting its own product or feature?
product_pr.true: A company announces or promotes its own product, feature or service.
product_pr.false: It is not a company promoting its own product.

sensational.q: Does the title overstate, bait or sensationalize?
sensational.true: The title is clickbait, overstated or sensational.
sensational.false: The title is plain and accurate in tone.

paywalled.q: Is this story's source usually behind a paywall?
paywalled.true: The source usually requires a subscription to read.
paywalled.false: The source is usually free to read.
